items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The passage presents what follows as a command spoken by the LORD to Moses.

items.quote: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering:
items.claim: Moses is told to give Aaron and his sons a set rule ("law") for the burnt offering, which places the priestly line in charge of the rite.
items.mechanism: passing ritual law down to the priesthood

items.quote: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning,
items.claim: The text says the burnt offering gets its name from being burned on the altar all night until morning.

items.quote: and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
items.claim: The altar fire is required to stay burning.
